description:
PROBLEM TYPE: LP
PROBLEM INFO:

- An economy consists of several industries. 
- Each unit produced by one of the industries (a unit will be taken as £1’s worth of value of production) requires inputs from possibly its own industry as well as other industries. 
- Industry \var{k} requires \var{inputone_{k, j}} input from industy \var{j}.
- Industry \var{k} requires \var{manpowerone_{k}} units of manpower.
- There is a time lag in the economy so that the output in year t + 1 requires an input in year t.
- Output from an industry may also be used to build productive capacity for itself or other industries in future years.
- To give unit increases (capacity for £1’s worth of extra production) in productive capacity of industry \var{k}, \var{j} units of industry \var{inputtwo_{k, j}} and \var{manpowertwo{k}} units of manpower are needed.
- Input from an industry in year t results in a (permanent) increase in productive capacity in year t + 2.
- Stocks of goods may be held from year to year. 
- At present (year 0), the stocks of industry \var{k} is \var{stock_{k}}, and the capacity of industry \var{k} is \var{capacity_{k}}.
- An exogenous consumption requirement of \var{demand_{k}} units from industry \var{k} has to be satisfied in every year except year 0.


INPUT FORMAT:

{
    "inputone": [[inputone_{k, j} for j in 1,...,K] for k in 1,...,K],
    "manpowerone": [manpowerone_{k} for k in 1,...,K],
    "inputtwo": [[inputtwo_{k, j} for j in 1,...,K] for k in 1,...,K],
    "manpowertwo": [manpowertwo_{k} for k in 1,...,K],
    "stock": [stock_{k} for k in 1,...,K],
    "capacity": [capacity_{k} for k in 1,...,K],
    "demand": [demand_{k} for k in 1,...,K]
}


OBJECTIVE: Maximize the total manpower requirement over five years

OUTPUT INFO:

- \var{produce} represents the amount of units produced by each industry in each year
- \var{buildcapa} represents the amount of units used to build productive capacity for each industry in each year
- \var{stockhold} represents the amount of stock of each industry held in each year

OUTPUT FORMAT:

{
    "produce": [[produce_{k, t} for t in 1,...,T] for k in 1,...,K],
    "buildcapa": [[buildcapa_{k, t} for t in 1,...,T] for k in 1,...,K],
    "stockhold": [[stock_{k, t} for t in 1,...,T] for for k in 1,...,K]
}

K.definition: The number of years over which the total manpower requirement is maximized

NumIndustries.definition: The number of industries in the economy

ManpowerOne.definition: Manpower requirements for operations one in each industry

ManpowerTwo.definition: Manpower requirements for operations two in each industry

Stock.definition: Stock level of product k at the beginning of the year

Capacity.definition: Production capacity for product k for the year

Demand.definition: Demand for product k for the year

InputOne.definition: Input one coefficient for product k with respect to product j

InputTwo.definition: Input two coefficient for product k with respect to product j

objective.description: "Maximize the total manpower requirement over five years"

constraints.description: Production of industry k in year t must not exceed the available productive capacity of industry k in year t
Available productive capacity of industry k in year t equals initial capacity plus all capacity additions decided in years up to t-2 (since capacity built in year τ becomes available in year τ+2)

For each industry k and year t, total available stock equals stock carried over from year t-1 plus production in year t minus amounts used as intermediate inputs for production in year t+1 minus amounts used for capacity building in year t minus demand in year t (for t ≥ 1)
constraints.formulation:
$\forall k,\; stockhold[k,1] = Stock[k] + produce[k,1] - \sum_{i=1}^{NumIndustries} InputOne[i,k] \cdot produce[i,2] - \sum_{i=1}^{NumIndustries} InputTwo[i,k] \cdot buildcapa[i,1] - Demand[k]$ 

$\forall k,\; \forall t = 2,\dots,K-1,\; stockhold[k,t] = stockhold[k,t-1] + produce[k,t] - \sum_{i=1}^{NumIndustries} InputOne[i,k] \cdot produce[i,t+1] - \sum_{i=1}^{NumIndustries} InputTwo[i,k] \cdot buildcapa[i,t] - Demand[k]$ 

$\forall k,\; stockhold[k,K] = stockhold[k,K-1] + produce[k,K] - \sum_{i=1}^{NumIndustries} InputTwo[i,k] \cdot buildcapa[i,K] - Demand[k]$
constraints.code:
for k in range(NumIndustries):
    # Year 1 (t = 0 in Python indexing)
    model.addConstr(
        stockhold[k, 0] ==
        Stock[k]
        + produce[k, 0]
        - sum(InputOne[i][k] * produce[i, 1] for i in range(NumIndustries))
        - sum(InputTwo[i][k] * buildcapa[i, 0] for i in range(NumIndustries))
        - Demand[k]
    )

    # Years 2 to K-1 (t = 1 to K-2 in Python indexing)
    for t in range(1, K - 1):
        model.addConstr(
            stockhold[k, t] ==
            stockhold[k, t - 1]
            + produce[k, t]
            - sum(InputOne[i][k] * produce[i, t + 1] for i in range(NumIndustries))
            - sum(InputTwo[i][k] * buildcapa[i, t] for i in range(NumIndustries))
            - Demand[k]
        )

    # Year K (t = K-1 in Python indexing)
    model.addConstr(
        stockhold[k, K - 1] ==
        stockhold[k, K - 2]
        + produce[k, K - 1]
        - sum(InputTwo[i][k] * buildcapa[i, K - 1] for i in range(NumIndustries))
        - Demand[k]
    )

constraints.description: For each industry j and year t, the total amount of product j used as intermediate input in year t equals the sum over all industries k of InputOne[k,j] multiplied by production of industry k in year t+1 (due to one-year time lag)
constraints.formulation: $\\forall j = 1, \\dots, \\text{NumIndustries}, \\; \\forall t = 1, \\dots, K-1:\\; \\text{(Total intermediate use of product } j \\text{ in year } t) = \\sum_{k=1}^{\\text{NumIndustries}} InputOne[k,j] \\cdot produce[k,t+1]$

constraints.description: Initial production capacity of industry k in year 1 equals the given Capacity[k]
constraints.code:
for k in range(NumIndustries):
    model.addConstr(capacityLevel[k, 0] == Capacity[k])

constraints.description: Total manpower used in each year equals the sum over all industries k of ManpowerOne[k] times production in year t plus ManpowerTwo[k] times buildcapa in year t
constraints.formulation: $\\forall t = 1, \\dots, K:\\; totalManpower[t] = \\sum_{k=1}^{NumIndustries} \\left( ManpowerOne[k] \\cdot produce[k,t] + ManpowerTwo[k] \\cdot buildcapa[k,t] \\right)$

constraints.description: All production variables produce[k,t] must be nonnegative
All capacity-building variables buildcapa[k,t] must be nonnegative
All stockholding variables stockhold[k,t] must be nonnegative

produce.definition: Amount of units produced by each industry k in each year t

capacityLevel.definition: Available productive capacity of each industry k in each year t

buildcapa.definition: Amount of units used to build productive capacity for each industry k in each year t

stockhold.definition: Amount of stock of each industry k held at the end of each year t

totalManpower.definition: Total manpower used in each year t
